summary: Frontend-only re-test after structural/color updates. All 7 request items verified end-to-end on the public URL. Home loaded with 0 console errors. Hero two-column layout renders with 'Gold Skin' / 'Spa & Beauty' headline, trust stats (4.9 / 8,000+ / 15+), floating review card and Board-Certified badge card. Hero CTAs scroll correctly (hero-book-btn -> contact, hero-services-btn -> services). Navbar renders exactly [About, Services, Results, Gift Cards, FAQ] with Book Now button; no Contact/Gallery links. Section order verified: hero -> marquee -> about -> services -> gallery -> gift-cards -> lead-capture -> contact -> faq (FAQ last before footer). Lead Capture is on ivory bg (rgb(241,233,218)); empty submit -> error toast, valid email -> success toast + field cleared. Contact section shows 3 cards (form / info / map) with iframe visible; contact-phone field present; empty submit -> error toast, valid name+email -> success toast + fields reset. Marquee renders on ivory bg with all six words and ✦ accents.

issues: Copy microcopy says 'Rated by 800+ clients' while spec references 4.9 rating; the 800+ vs 8,000+ (Treatments) is intentional per code but worth double-checking with product.

critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx defines an unused `inputCls` constant — dead code, can be removed.
Contact form has no client-side email format validation (only non-empty check) — acceptable for demo but flagging.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All spec items in iteration_2 pass. Hero right column (photo + floating review + Board-Certified badge), contact 3-card layout with iframe, ivory Lead Capture, ivory Marquee, updated nav (no Contact/Gallery), and FAQ-last section order all verified. 0 console/page errors. Lenis smooth scroll requires ~2s wait between scroll actions.
